warranty.notes: 60% of capacity at 10 years or 16.45 MWh life cycle discharge per 5 kWh battery pack (IS-BATT-5000-ES), whichever comes first. The power module (IS-BATT-5000-BMS) has its own time-only warranty. Requires a connection to the iStore monitoring platform and installation within a month of purchase.

notes: IS-BATT-5000/10000/15000-S0: one IS-BATT-5000-BMS power module with 1-3 IS-BATT-5000-ES modules of 5 kWh, 100% usable; up to 3 modules per inverter and normally up to 3 inverters in a plant. Built by Huawei (LUNA2000-compatible).
